description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release makes task delivery easier, improves long conversations and desktop memory cleanup, fixes GitLab image previews, and updates agents and built-in skills.
New
- Include uncommitted task changes when creating or updating a PR/MR, with a file list and editable commit message before committing and pushing to the task branch.
Improved
- Streaming replies and long execution histories are more responsive, with steps loading as you scroll and fewer blank areas, missing steps or unexpected scroll jumps in chat and sub-agent panels.
- Built-in expert skills are updated to Superpowers 7.0.2, improving plan execution when skills are installed individually.
- Built-in research skills are updated to scientific-agent-skills 2.72.0, expanding paper lookup to 18 scholarly sources and improving data analysis, scientific figures and research reviews.
- Updated CodeBuddy to 2.184.0, Kimi Code to 2.6.1, Qoder to 1.1.88 and Antigravity to 1.5.0.
Fixed
- Reduced memory retained after closing desktop conversation tabs or sub-agent panels while they are still loading, and fixed cases where reopening a conversation could remain stuck waiting. (#1148 by @kogekiplay)
- GitLab issue and comment images display correctly across desktop, Web and remote workspaces, including private uploads and images hosted in object storage.
- CodeBuddy file previews no longer include extra reading hints as file content, keeping the displayed content and line numbers accurate.
Thanks to @kogekiplay for contributing to this release.
